name: Constants
description: Fields of the type that its create sets and nothing changes after: an update that changes one, a caller's or one a behavior's operation applies, is refused at the field, unless the caller holds the config's permission. A field the create leaves absent stays absent. What routes an instance, such as a step's kind or the key a blueprint stamped it with, stays what its create gave it.

fields.description: The type's own top-level fields, by JSON key, that keep the value their create gives them.

permission.description: The permission a caller needs to change them after the create; nobody may when absent.

oneWay.description: Own fields, by JSON key, that move one way after the create: up, a boolean that only turns true or a number or a date-time that only grows; down, one that only turns false or shrinks. No value is below every value, so clearing a field is a move down and giving a field with none a value a move up. A move the other way is vetoed (one_way) unless the caller holds the config's permission; a create gives any value. A field is in fields or here, not both. A table's alone: an engine type refuses it.

vetoes.description: An update that moves a oneWay field the other way, by a caller without the config's permission; details give the field, its direction, its current value and the one the update gives it, null for none. A table's alone: an engine type refuses oneWay.
